title: Отчетные ОКВЭД не совпали с заявленной деятельностью у 28% компаний

В качестве третьих лиц привлечены ООО «Яндекс», ООО «Кех Екоммерц» («Авито») и ООО «Фирма "Стом"» (Betboom).

snippet: Brazilian leader Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva staged a surprise comeback to secure a fourth term in office, extending a presidency that has overseen deepening ties with China and sporadic clashes with the United States. The 80-year-old left-winger is the first person to win the presidency after losing the first round of voting since Brazil.

This figure is considerably lower than the widely cited figure reached by Nasa, which previously estimated Greenland’s annual loss to be nearly 270.
